title: 8850 Ice House Drive
address: 8850 Ice House Drive, North Richland Hills, TX 76180
description: Welcome to this spacious townhome in the charming HomeTown community of North Richland Hills, offering more than 2,200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The two-story floor plan features three bedrooms and two full baths upstairs, while the first floor is dedicated to living and entertaining with a private study, additional bonus or flex space, and a convenient half bath. At the heart of the home is an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features an impressive island measuring approximately 11 feet wide, a gas cooktop, built-in wall oven and microwave, abundant cabinetry, and two spacious pantries for exceptional storage. From the kitchen, enjoy open views into the living and dining areas, creating a bright and connected gathering space. A truly unique feature of this property is its private, fenced backyard and detached garage--an offering found in only a small number of townhomes within the neighborhood. HomeTown is known for its inviting community atmosphere, miles of walking trails, scenic pond and canal, and convenient access to shopping, dining, recreation, and everyday essentials. NRH Centre and Peppa Pig Theme Park are nearby, while highly regarded Birdville ISD schools are within walking distance. With generous living space, flexible rooms, exceptional kitchen storage, and a rare private backyard, this home offers a combination of comfort, convenience, and community that is hard to find.

title: 9636 Air Park Drive
description: Rate takeoffs and landings from your back patio! This lovely, move-in ready home faces the Pecan Plantation 0TX1 airstrip. The hangar includes an air conditioned shop and storage mezzanine with a flat approach and quick access to the runway. The home features 3 beds and 2.5 baths with formal dining and living rooms with 9 foot ceilings and crown molding throughout. The master suite includes a sitting room with access to one of two covered patios. The cozy family room includes a wood burning fireplace opening to the granite topped kitchen with custom cabinets, pantry, and stainless appliances. The sitting room, living room, breakfast nook, and family room have floor to ceiling windows for an unobstructed view of flight operations. Pecan Plantation 0TX1 is located 48 NM southwest of KDFW. Resurfaced in 2024, This private runway is 3616 x 50 at appx. 710 MSL. It has pilot controlled runway lights with 2 light PAPI, and a private daytime only GPS approach available to registered pilots. The Pecan Plantation community includes full time gated access security, a complete shopping center with medical, grocery, food, banking, fuel and car wash and more. It includes 62 miles of private roads serving approximately 3600 homes. Amenities include 2 airstrips, 2 golf courses, an 80 slip marina with a barbecue restaurant and a private boat ramp, 17 miles of Brazos River with 3 beaches, an RV campground with an archery range and pellet gun range, a club house with an integral 20 room hotel and fine dining, tennis and pickleball courts, 19th Hole Sports Grill, 2 swimming pools, an activities center, the very active EAA 983, and numerous social clubs with endless year-round activities.

title: 4016 Kimbell Drive
description: Nestled in the sought-after Heritage HOA master planned community, this beautifully maintained home offers extensive upgrades that enhance comfort, efficiency, and long-term value. Inside, the desirable floorplan features tall ceilings, plantation shutters, generously sized rooms, double staircases, and abundant custom storage with built-in shelving and cabinetry. The main level primary suite provides a serene retreat with granite vanities, a relaxing garden tub, and a spacious walk-in closet. A guest room with its own private full bath is also conveniently located on the first floor. The spacious kitchen is ideal for daily living and entertaining, offering ample cabinetry with pull-out drawers in all lower cabinets and the pantry, a coffee bar, center island, premium granite countertops, Bosch dishwasher, smart-touch faucet, and a new induction cooktop. Upstairs includes two oversized bedrooms--each with walk-in closets and a shared Jack and Jill bath--plus a large game room, a media room wired for 5.2 surround sound, and a bonus room with built-in cabinetry and desk perfect for study or crafting. The 3-car garage features upgraded polycuramine flooring for durability and a clean finish. The level, private backyard includes space for play or a future pool, along with a cedar-covered patio with ceiling fans, outlets, and canned lighting for year-round enjoyment. Major updates include a new first-floor AC and furnace, landscaping with new trees, stone edging and pavers, a Low-E back door and new energy-efficient windows, two new hot water heaters with recirculating system, a Class 4 hail-resistant roof, smart Wi-Fi thermostats, a Hunter Wi-Fi irrigation controller, surge and lightning protection, updated lighting, and more! Enjoy Heritage's amenities--7 pools, splash park, fitness center, clubhouse, playgrounds, volleyball, tennis and pickleball courts, miles of trails, HOA events, Keller ISD schools, and a prime location near shopping and dining.

title: 3004 Rolling Wood Lane
description: Received Multiple Offers-Appraisers if using this as a comp please call listing agent for details. Lenders appraisal had mistakes and they would not consider an ROV. Custom-designed & reimagined, this one-of-a-kind luxury transitional home is nestled within the exclusive gated community of Rolling Wood in Keller, TX, just minutes from Colleyville & Southlake. This extraordinary single-story residence blends sophisticated design, timeless elegance, & exceptional livability with artistic details by Sally Lynn Home at every turn. Inside, beautiful hardwood floors, coffered ceilings, dramatic lighting & refined finishes curate a polished yet welcoming atmosphere. The chef-inspired 2024 remodeled kitchen is a true culinary showpiece featuring all-stainless GE Monogram appliances, a commercial gas cooktop, built-in refrigerators, striking granites, mosaic tiles, & a large walk-in pantry. The beautifully designed living room serves as the heart of the home, with a stone fireplace, wood-beamed vaulted ceilings & sweeping views of the patio & pool. Generously sized secondary bedrooms provide comfort & privacy while the study & media room rounds out the home. Retreat to the light-filled primary suite with seating area & serene views of the backyard sanctuary. Its spa-inspired bath offers dual vanities, a walk-in shower, & a truly enviable & thoughtfully designed Custom Closet. Outdoor living is nothing short of spectacular. The private backyard is anchored by a stunning saltwater pool with water features & travertine, creating a resort-like retreat for everyday enjoyment. Multiple covered lounge areas & a dedicated grilling station with Hestan gas grill make entertaining effortless, & insect misting system ensures memorable summer gatherings. Practical luxury continues with a Generac generator, new roof, & dual-filtration HVAC system with Ultraviolet purification. Both completed in '24. 3-car garage offers epoxy flooring & convenient attic storage access by VersaLift.
